name: diag_mw_note
note: To turn on the appliance, use point_prompt_molmo(image, "start button") to locate its button/switch in the current view, then solve_ik to a position slightly in front of it (reduce x by 0.03 m) with fingers pointing forward (quaternion wxyz [0.7071,0,0.7071,0]) and move_to_joints to press it.
